title: Got the job in Wisdom Hely’s year we married. Six years. Ten years ago: ninetyfour he died yes that’s right the big fire at Arnott’s.
html_source:
These are key passages that help us figure out historical timelines. Bloom tells us that Rudy passed away ten years ago (he was born in December 1893 and died in 1894 after only eleven days) and that he started working at Hely’s the year he got married (1888). It appears that he worked there for six years. His daughter Milly was born June 15, 1889.

According to Gifford, the big fire was May 4, 1894.
